function Analytics({ stats = { total: 0, completed: 0, remaining: 0 }, userRole = 'User' }) { const completionRate = stats.total ? Math.round((stats.completed / stats.total) * 100) : 0; const workStatus = completionRate >= 80 ? 'Strong progress' : completionRate >= 50 ? 'Steady progress' : completionRate > 0 ? 'Needs attention' : 'No work started yet'; const cards = [ { label: 'Total tasks', value: stats.total, note: 'All tracked work' }, { label: 'Completed', value: stats.completed, note: 'Finished tasks' }, { label: 'Remaining', value: stats.remaining, note: 'Still in progress' }, { label: 'Completion rate', value: `${completionRate}%`, note: 'Overall productivity' }, ]; return (

Workspace analytics

{userRole === 'Admin' ? 'Team performance' : 'Your performance'}

Track progress and identify where work is getting done.

{cards.map((card) => (
{card.label} {card.value} {card.note}
))}

Summary

{workStatus}

{stats.total === 0 ? 'There are no tasks to analyze yet.' : `${stats.completed} of ${stats.total} tasks are complete, and ${stats.remaining} still need attention.`}

); } export default Analytics;
